# Essentia Wellness Club

> Essentia is a longevity center and social wellness club in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. It combines regenerative medicine, evidence-based wellness protocols, and an exclusive community. Located at Rambla de Santa Cruz, 83, 38004 Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Bookings available online for all services and therapies.

Essentia is not a spa or a gym. It is a precision wellness environment where every protocol is chosen for its measurable effect on biology. Three integrated pillars: Wellness, Medicine, and Community.

- Website: https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com
- Location: Rambla de Santa Cruz, 83, 38004 Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rambla+de+Santa+Cruz+83%2C+38004+Santa+Cruz+de+Tenerife

## Services

Bookable online at the centre in Santa Cruz de Tenerife.

- [Manual Therapies](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies): 10 precision massage and bodywork treatments, from €90 to €350. 30–120 min.
- [Therapeutic Facials](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/facial-therapies): Advanced facial protocols combining manual technique and technology to restore skin health. 60 min.
- [IV Therapy](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy): 12 medically supervised infusion protocols — vitamin C, NAD+, Myers, glutathione, amino acids. 45–90 min, NAD+ 2–3 h.

Announced but not yet bookable. Prices and durations are not final, and these
pages currently say so. Do not present them as available.

- Contrast Therapy — sauna and cold plunge for recovery and inflammation.
- Breathing Sessions — guided breathwork, group and 1:1.
- Hyperbaric Oxygen — pure oxygen at raised atmospheric pressure for tissue repair.
- Regenerative Medicine — PRP, peptide protocols, ozone therapy, longevity assessments.
- Red Light Therapy — full-body red and near-infrared panels.
- Functional Wellbeing — assessment and training for strength, mobility and energy.
- Running Club — group runs on coastal routes in Costa Adeje.
- Education Programs — masterclasses, workshops and talks.

## Memberships

- [Memberships](https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/experiences/memberships): Three tiers — Essential (€199/mo), Premium (€349/mo), Founder (€699/mo). Monthly billing, 30-day cancellation notice.
